name: Station controller watchdog alarm interface
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Reports the selected controller's documented watchdog or health failure indication.
description: Reports the selected controller's documented watchdog or health failure indication. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Controller health output” at the input and “Station controller fault alarm” at the output. Watchdog coverage has defined limits.
